extra_params.video_script: Chuck Wepner knocked down Muhammad Ali, at least officially. In Part 1, a club fighter nicknamed the Bayonne Bleeder got a title shot against Ali. The knockdown came in the ninth round. But Ali said Wepner had stepped on his foot and pushed him. Film of the fight backed Ali up, though Wepner always insisted it was real. Wepner kept fighting anyway. The referee finally stopped it with just 19 seconds left in the final round. Wepner needed 23 stitches. And a little-known actor watching that fight was about to write a Best Picture winner. Subscribe so you don't miss Part 3.
